01 · The brand decision

Connected Utility is the core. The other territories become expressions.

The selected direction is not the most decorative option. It is the option that remains coherent when a customer is choosing, authorising, waiting, reconciling or asking for help.

01 · SELECTED

Connected Utility

Core identity

02 · EXPRESSION

Regional Clarity

Market, route and acquisition expression

03 · BEHAVIOUR

Calm Momentum

Progress, status and recovery behaviour

Selected core

Connection becomes a disciplined product behaviour.

Two linked forms represent sender and recipient, person and purpose, funding and source, amount and fee, request and status. The mark stays simple; the system around it carries the intelligence.

KCB remains the institutional trust anchor.
Pamoja remains useful beyond one corridor, campaign or rail.
The system works in successful, pending and difficult states.
02 · Human psychology

Make customers feel in control—not merely inspired.

Cross-border money decisions combine care, obligation, uncertainty and risk. The brand must reduce cognitive effort while preserving emotional relevance.

01

Agency before excitement

“I understand what I am choosing.”
DESIGN RESPONSE

One decision at a time, explicit funding, visible totals and direct action labels.

AVOID

Urgency, celebration or motion before the customer understands the commitment.

02

Connection with purpose

“This is linked to someone or something that matters.”
DESIGN RESPONSE

Pair people, providers and purposes without turning togetherness into sentimentality.

AVOID

Generic community imagery, guilt, nostalgia or an undifferentiated idea of Africa.

03

Certainty without overclaiming

“I know what is confirmed, pending or unresolved.”
DESIGN RESPONSE

Typed status, references, safe next actions and provider-controlled outcome language.

AVOID

Green completion cues before confirmation or promises of instant delivery everywhere.

04

Proof builds repeat trust

“I can verify, explain and reconcile what happened.”
DESIGN RESPONSE

Receipts, Activity, masked records, copyable references and accessible support.

AVOID

Decorative success screens that leave no durable record or recovery path.

THE HUMAN PRINCIPLE

The customer should leave each step with more clarity than they entered it.

RECOMMENDED CUSTOMER-FACING PAIR

Stay close to what matters.

KCB Pamoja helps you move money and pay for the people and purposes that matter.

Do not stack the slogans.

Use one brand thought, one page purpose and one action per surface. The strategic idea is expressed through the experience, not repeated inside every card.

04 · Market opportunity

Three opportunities. One disciplined product system.

The opportunity expands when Pamoja connects value movement to context, confidence and proof. Every opportunity remains subject to corridor, partner, regulatory, data and operating-model approval.

US$451.85mFormal Kenyan diaspora inflows · August 2026Formal channels only; not a KCB revenue forecast. 91% cashEstimated household remittance inflow share · Jun 2024–May 2025Supports digital-plus-assisted design, not a forced cash-to-app assumption. 55 + 8AU countries and Regional Economic Communities in the AfCFTA frameInstitutional scope does not prove route-level availability. 19 Jun–17 JulCurrently announced AFCON 2027 tournament windowScheduled dates; venue, rights and operating details require revalidation.
DIASPORA

From transfer to dependable support

CBK reported US$451.85m in formal inflows in August 2026.

The 2025 household survey estimated KSh931.8bn of inflows for June 2024–May 2025, with 91% in cash. Pamoja can connect a transfer to purpose, recipient certainty, assisted access and a usable record.

Family support and self-to-self funding
Education, health and housing payments
Clear fee, rate, status and receipt records
CBK / KNBS household evidence ↗
INTRA-AFRICA TRADE

Make regional obligations easier to understand

AfCFTA brings together 55 AU countries and eight regional communities.

PAPSS describes local-currency settlement and optional Request-to-Pay and escrow capabilities. These establish infrastructure context, not proof of every KCB route. Pamoja can connect invoice, currency, fee, status and reconciliation on approved corridors.

SME supplier and distributor payments
Merchant and service-provider collections
Reconciliation-ready references
AfCFTA official overview ↗
AFCON 2027 POC

A time-bound East African learning environment

CAF currently schedules the finals for 19 June–17 July 2027.

Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda are confirmed co-hosts, while planning and inspections continue. The event can test travel, family support, local-currency spend and merchant use—not an official product claim or demand forecast.

Cross-border fan and family support
Travel, hospitality and verified merchant journeys
Multi-market acquisition and service learning

05 · Future marketing

Market the purpose, then prove the service.

Build emotional relevance at the top of the journey and increase functional proof as a customer moves toward action.

01

See me

Specific diaspora, trader, family, student, health, housing and merchant stories—not generic aspiration.

02

Show me

Explain the task, route, eligibility, fees, expected timing and what is illustrative or available.

03

Let me act

Direct CTAs, clear funding and transaction-bound authorisation without campaign distraction.

04

Keep me informed

Status, references, safe recovery and support maintain trust after acquisition.

05

Let me prove it

Receipts and Activity turn a promise into a record customers and businesses can use.

Diaspora acquisition

Purpose-led stories, corridor education, community partnerships, search and CRM journeys that lead to transparent task completion.

Trade and merchant growth

Supplier, distributor and merchant cases built around records, reconciliation and repeat obligations—not lifestyle claims.

Event and campaign layers

Rights-cleared, time-bound programmes that introduce a real use case while keeping the product and support hierarchy intact.

06 · 2027 learning portfolio

Prove the proposition in bounded POCs.

A POC should answer a business question and a customer question. It should not simulate scale, imply rights or hide the operating responsibilities needed for live money movement.

POC 00 · CONTROL

Corridor and compliance control tower

Internal product, compliance, treasury, operations, risk, data and support owners.

Create one source of truth for route eligibility, currencies, participants, limits, fees, liquidity, controls, reversals and ownership before any claim.

MEASURE

· Routes with named owner
· Quote reconciliation
· Exception ownership
· Written sign-offs
· Claim traceability

GATE
Every route is marked available, unavailable or approval required—with evidence.
POC 01 · DIASPORA

Diaspora purpose payment

Diaspora customers supporting a person or paying an approved provider.

Move money or pay directly for education, healthcare, housing and everyday support—with visible cost, purpose and proof.

MEASURE

· Completed onboarding
· Quote conversion
· Status comprehension
· Repeat intent
· Support contacts

GATE
Start with one licensed source market, one destination market and approved providers.
POC 02 · TRADE

Regional SME obligation

Small businesses paying a supplier, distributor, merchant or biller across an approved corridor.

Connect invoice purpose, beneficiary, currency, fees, rail, reference and payment status in one record.

MEASURE

· Time to create payment
· Reference accuracy
· Reconciliation quality
· Failure recovery
· Repeat use

GATE
Confirm business KYC, limits, FX, tax, data and rail accountability.
POC 03 · AFCON 2027

Local-currency spend and travel companion

Visitors, families, supporters, hospitality businesses and approved local merchants.

Test payment education, local-currency understanding, current acceptance, support and cash fallback in a time-bound context.

MEASURE

· Acquisition by market
· Local-currency comprehension
· Merchant discovery
· Task success
· Support signals

GATE
No official event language or live-money claim without rights, route and regulatory approval.
POC 04 · TRUST

Fraud resilience and inclusion

Digital, assisted, low-data and lower-frequency customers across every proposed cohort.

Red-team wrong-recipient, phishing, fake travel offers, device loss, duplicate payment, outage and delayed-settlement scenarios.

MEASURE

· Scam recognition
· Recipient verification
· Recovery confidence
· Assisted completion
· Support workload

GATE
Stop any journey that creates critical misunderstanding of cost, recipient, status or recovery.
PROPOSED SEQUENCE
Q4 2026–Q1 2027
Route matrix, rights review, discovery and synthetic quote prototypes.
Evidence and feasibility
Q1–Q2 2027
Family, trade and travel prototypes; inclusion testing and fraud red-team.
Comprehension
Q2 2027
Closed low-value or sandbox pilots on approved routes; merchant and support rehearsals.
Operating readiness
19 Jun–17 Jul 2027
Run only approved, bounded experiences and capture route, success, failure and support evidence.
No automatic expansion
Q3 2027
Compare results with pre-agreed thresholds and publish limitations internally.
Scale, revise or stop
RIGHTS AND CLAIMS BOUNDARY

Use the tournament as a potential market-learning context.

Do not describe KCB Pamoja as an official AFCON product, use competition marks, or imply live visitor and merchant acceptance without formal rights, route, provider, regulatory and operating approvals.

07 · Stakeholder decisions

What we are asking the room to select.

End with decisions that can be carried into customer validation, operating-model work and POC design.

1

Identity direction

Confirm Connected Utility as the core KCB Pamoja identity.

2

Promise hierarchy

Confirm the descriptor, welcome promise and strategic idea as separate layers.

3

Priority customer

Select the first diaspora, regional-trade or purpose-payment cohort.

4

POC corridor

Choose one bounded source–destination context with named responsibilities.

5

AFCON 2027 role

Define whether it is a research context, campaign layer or live POC—subject to rights.

6

Governance

Name owners for brand, product, compliance, rights, operations, data, support and measurement.

RECOMMENDED DECISION

Approve Connected Utility as the brand system to take into customer and operating-model validation.

Approve the promise hierarchy as a working architecture. Keep product descriptor and status language functional. Keep the strategic idea selective. Approve the 2027 opportunities as bounded tests—not as public launch claims.

Evidence and governance

Sources used for the market frame.

Verified facts retain source and timing. Strategic implications and POCs remain proposals until tested and approved.
